title: Rapid laser synthesis of medium-entropy alloy nanostructures for neutral seawater electrolysis
content:
Sustainable Energy Fuels, 2025, Advance Article
DOI: 10.1039/D4SE01572J, Paper
Aik Jong Tan, Yunchao Xie, Zhenru Chen, Jian Lin
We report the direct laser-induced synthesis of medium-entropy alloy FeNiCoRu nanoparticles for neutral seawater electrolysis with excellent long-duration.
